 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Topstories News PCSO Lotto Results: Lone Megalotto 6/45 winner gets P15M in November 2 draw 
 By GMA News Published November 2, 2026 10:00pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. SCREENSHOT FROM PCSO VIDEO A Megalotto 6/45 bettor is P15 million richer after the November 2 draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Monday evening.
 The winning Megalotto numbers of 11-02-26-07-44-05 unlocked a jackpot prize totaling P15,000,000.
 PCSO said the lucky bettor purchased the winning ticket from an outlet in Pasay City.
 The previous Megalotto winner bagged over P115 million on October 16.
